title: Create video
intro: Develop an idea into a script, a shared cast, approved shots and an exported video. Provider requests use your configured accounts.

project.name: Project name
project.deleteHint: Delete this project and its unshared local assets? Active jobs must be resolved first.

providers.emptyLlm: No writing provider is configured. Add an OpenAI-compatible provider under Translation, then enter its base URL, API key and model name.
providers.llmConsent: Authorize paid writing requests for this session
providers.authorizeLlm: Select a writing provider and authorize its session budget first.

quick.title: Test video generation from a prompt
quick.hint: Script writing is temporarily hidden. Enter a prompt to prepare one test shot without characters or dialogue. Review and approve the shot, then request a quote and approve the cost before calling the video API.
quick.selectProvider: Select a video provider above to see supported durations and formats.
quick.prepared: The shot is ready. Review and approve it in Storyboard, then request a quote under Generation.

discovery.title: Clarify the idea
discovery.suggest: Let AI suggest the remaining details
discovery.confirmHint: Review AI suggestions in Brief and confirm them explicitly before writing.

script.structuredHint: Edit each scene and review dialogue length. Saving creates a revision; dependent shots may need approval again.
script.importHint: The imported original is preserved. Analyzing gaps and rewriting are separate actions.

brief.empty: Clarify the idea or ask AI to suggest remaining details to create a brief.
brief.editHint: Editing an approved brief creates a new draft. Review and confirm it again; existing footage stays available for review.

cast.sharedHint: This character library is shared across the series. Stable IDs keep dialogue and shot references linked after renaming. Approved references are pinned to revisions.
cast.name: Name
cast.imageCost: Image generation incurs provider charges. Set a spending ceiling and approve this request.
cast.voiceHint: Save the character voice before approving shots. Use the same TTS engine when exporting dialogue; narration uses the global export voice.

storyboard.hint: Review identity, camera, lighting, timing and continuity. Editing approved inputs marks existing footage for review.

generation.hint: Select shots, request a quote and approve the batch budget before any paid submission. Unknown submissions require reconciliation.
generation.unknownCost: Provider price is unknown — set an explicit ceiling
generation.consent: I approve the provider charges within this ceiling
generation.reviewChecklist: Check identity, clothing, action, continuity and audio before choosing this take.
generation.reconcileHint: Check your provider dashboard first. Attach a known remote job ID, or confirm with evidence that no job was accepted. This action does not submit a new job.
generation.notSubmitted: I checked the provider and confirm this request was not accepted
generation.keepOldConsent: I explicitly accept this take using its earlier approved inputs

export.hint: Export assembles the selected accepted takes in storyboard order.
export.audioHint: Narration/TTS requires configured voices. Native dialogue must be reviewed. Accurate lip sync depends on the selected provider.
export.missingTakes: Every shot needs a current accepted video take before export.
export.nativeReview: I reviewed native dialogue, language and audio for all selected takes
export.audioConsent: Authorize audio synthesis within this budget

settings.title: Episode settings
settings.hint: These visible defaults guide the brief and storyboard. Provider capability checks run before production.
